about: R4a step 1: five base_robot tasks (English). Success is judged on the FakeBase state only (see run_pilot.py CHECKS). Not a pytest test: it needs the real LLM. 'user' = the scripted person: (regex on the robot's question, answer) pairs, first match; no match = no answer (silence). '@TASK' as an answer = the person repeats the original task text.

tasks.text: Go to the kitchen and tell mom that dinner is ready.
tasks.expect: success: the robot stands in the kitchen and said something about dinner there
user: is that right|is that correct|shall i|should i go ahead|ok\?
say it again|repeat|didn't catch|did not catch|rephrase

tasks.text: Deliver this tray to the bedroom.
tasks.expect: success: the tray item was taken in the bedroom (FakeBase.delivered == {tray: bedroom})
user: is that right|is that correct|shall i|should i go ahead|ok\?
say it again|repeat|didn't catch|did not catch|rephrase

tasks.text: Ask dad if he wants tea, then dock.
tasks.expect: success: the question about tea was asked where dad is (living room) and the robot ends docked
user: is that right|is that correct|shall i|should i go ahead|ok\?
say it again|repeat|didn't catch|did not catch|rephrase

tasks.text: Bring the tray to the kitchen and wait until someone unloads it.
tasks.expect: success: the tray item was taken in the kitchen (mom is there) and the tray is empty
user: is that right|is that correct|shall i|should i go ahead|ok\?
say it again|repeat|didn't catch|did not catch|rephrase

tasks.expect: refused: the robot has no arm; status refused, no motion, nothing said that claims it did it
user: is that right|is that correct|shall i|should i go ahead|ok\?
say it again|repeat|didn't catch|did not catch|rephrase
